correctness.rationale: On A=1, the tangent-center chart gives B=s²+2su,C=t²+2tv,D=s+u,E=t+v,F=st+tu+sv and determinant Δ=0. Eliminate u,v and t=(F−sE)/(D−s), obtaining P(s)=s²−2Ds+B and resultant/remainder −Δ. In the function field K=k(C,D,E,F) of determinant cubic, D²−B=−(F−DE)²/(C−E²). The irreducible prime C−E² has odd valuation in K, making P irreducible in any characteristic; its derivative is 2(s−D) except when char2, where zero derivative and B nonsquare give inseparable degree2. The rank-three tangent-cone vector bundle has Segre s₂=6; degree of cubic image3 independently gives 2. Generic field-extension degree and image are proved, not an assertion about every fibre.
